## About
Hi-Tech Import Automotive is a family owned and operated, full-service shop in Lakewood that specializes in Japanese imports. We work on Toyota, Lexus, Honda, Acura, Subaru and Scion, including Toyota, Lexus, Honda and Subaru hybrids. You get the same level of work you'd expect from a dealer, without the high dealer prices.
Our ASE certified technicians use top quality parts and the latest equipment, and we treat your vehicle as if it were our own. One reviewer wrote that Craig and his whole team are knowledgeable, skilled, friendly and honest, with pricing that's fair and transparent.
We're proud to serve Lakewood and the surrounding areas in Colorado, and we hold a 4.9 rating from 156 Google reviews.

## Services
- Tire rotation and wheel balancing / alignment: Keep your tires wearing evenly and your import tracking straight.
- Batteries, belts and hoses inspected and replaced: We check the parts that wear out quietly and replace them when it's time.
- A/C and heater service: Cool air in summer, real heat in a Colorado winter.
- Exhaust and emission's testing: Exhaust work and emissions testing for your import.
- Brakes serviced and replaced: Brake service and replacement done with quality parts.
- Oil, lube, filters and tune-ups: The regular maintenance that keeps your car running right.
- Cooling system service and flushing: Service and flushing to keep your engine at the right temperature.
- Fuel injection service and headlight restoration: Fuel injection service, plus restoring cloudy headlights.

## FAQ
Q: What vehicles do you work on?
A: We specialize in Japanese imports: Toyota and Toyota Hybrid, Lexus and Lexus Hybrid, Honda, Acura, Subaru, Subaru Hybrid and Scion.

Q: Will servicing my car here affect my manufacturer's warranty?
A: No. We service your vehicle and maintain your manufacturer's warranty, so you don't have to go to the dealer.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Give us a call or schedule an appointment online. We're open Monday through Friday and closed on weekends.
